Federica Gazzelloni is an actuary, statistician, data scientist, author and instructor working across health metrics, actuarial modelling, R and Python, data visualisation and reproducible research. She leads [R-Ladies Rome](https://www.meetup.com/it-IT/rladies-rome/) and the [Rome R Users Group](https://www.meetup.com/it-IT/rome-r-users-group/).

This workshop connects machine-learning concepts with practical epidemiological examples. We focus on clear modelling questions, reproducible code and careful interpretation.
